_doc: A body meets the street's poles (Prender-271, walls_about's street walls): a round at the head of the walker who stands nearest a lamp, pole or plate of the street at the corner (60, 8), fired from the side away from the post ({poleRound}: LookArgs; in this town a post at (56.2, -24), the walker 2.1 m from it), so the body falls towards it (a blow there was judged a roof burst, Psimulation-106, and knocked nobody down); a second after, the body nearest that post (setViewNear body at setView (56, 24): y is -z) close (120 px a metre) from four azimuths at 35 degrees and from above (80): the body against the post, no limb through it. The census (in_walls, street_walls) printed.
